findings.title: No drawing sheets exist, though the description relies on eight figures
findings.attack: [0018]-[0025] describe FIG. 1 to FIG. 8, but the package holds only a figure plan and drawing instructions, pending the inventors' sketches. 35 U.S.C. 113 requires drawings here; EPC Rule 56 and UK s.15(5) delete the references or re-date the application when drawings are missing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Prepare FIG. 1 to FIG. 8 from the registry.md instructions, reconciled with FIG-1.png and FIG-2.png, and file them with the description.

findings.title: US: multiple dependent claims serve as a basis for other multiple dependent claims
findings.attack: Claim 8 'The valve of any one of claims 1 to 7' refers to claim 6 'claim 1 or claim 5', itself multiple dependent; the same pattern appears in claims 17, 30, 48, 54 and many others. This is improper under 35 U.S.C. 112(e) and 37 CFR 1.75(c); such claims are objected to and not examined, and multiple-dependency fees apply.
findings.least_narrowing_action: File a US-specific claim set with single dependencies chosen by counsel; keep the EPO/UK set (Correction 2 shows claim 8 as an example).

findings.title: No abstract in the package
findings.attack: An abstract is required under 37 CFR 1.72(b) (at most 150 words), EPC Art. 78(1)(e) and Rule 47, and UK s.14(2)(c); none is in the package.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Write an abstract summarising claim 1 with the FIG. 2 reference signs.

findings.title: Lettered paragraph numbers [0034a], [0094a], [0132a]
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.52(b)(6) calls for consecutive four-digit bracketed paragraph numbers; lettered inserts are not conforming.

findings.title: FIG. 4A and FIG. 4B each combine two different views
findings.attack: [0021] 'FIG. 4A shows, in axial section and in end view' puts two different views under one figure number, contrary to 37 CFR 1.84(u)(1) and EPC Rule 46(2)(h).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Drop the end views, which add only D, already shown in section (Corrections 7 to 9); or renumber the views as FIG. 4A to 4D.

findings.title: Claims 57 to 60 are not grouped with the claims they depend on
findings.attack: '57. The valve of claim 20', '58. The valve of any one of claims 27 to 29', '59. The valve core of claim 42' and '60. The valve core of claim 45' follow method claims 52-56, contrary to EPC Rule 43(4).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Move them after claims 24, 29, 43 and 45 respectively and renumber (Correction 10).

findings.title: 'Inflation gas' carries no reference sign (66) in claims 1, 2 and 4
findings.attack: 'along which inflation gas passes the valve seat' (claims 1 and 2) and 'inflation gas from the inflation device' (claim 4) omit the sign 66 shown in FIG. 2, although every other numbered component carries its sign (EPC Rule 43(7)).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add '(66)' at the first mention in each independent claim (Corrections 11 to 13).

findings.title: Claimed tubeless tyre set-up and outward-deflected wiper ring are not shown in any figure
findings.attack: Claim 51 'a tubeless tyre set-up' and claims 28 and 45 'deflected outward by the purge shoulder (44)' are not drawn: FIG. 8 shows only an inner tube, and FIG. 3 shows the wiper ring 130 only undeflected. This is contrary to 37 CFR 1.83(a).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the deflected wiper ring in broken line to FIG. 3 and a labelled box for the tubeless tyre set-up to FIG. 8 (Corrections 14 and 15).

findings.title: The claims have no heading
findings.attack: claims.md begins '1. A valve (92) for an inflatable body (80)' with no heading; 37 CFR 1.75(h) and MPEP 608.01(m) expect claims on a separate sheet under a heading, as do the EPO and the UK IPO.

A3. The formal rules and claims-fee thresholds cited are stated from general knowledge of patent practice; the current fee amounts are not given, and counsel should confirm both.
A4. Substantive matters are not raised here. F-40a-1, F-40a-2 and F-40a-4 repeat the formal items F-30-3, F-30-8 and F-30-9 only to give exact corrections, and should be merged with them.
A5. Corrections 1, 3 and 10 describe actions because there is no literal text to replace, or the change is a relocation.
A6. figures.md and registry.md are working instructions for the draftsperson, not filing text, and are not treated as filed matter.
